title: Assignment 1: Foundations of Quantum Computation
subtitle: Synthesizing Chapters 1–6: Computability, Reversibility, Amplitudes, Measurement, and Multi-Qubit Systems
intro: This assignment brings together the foundational principles, configuration transitions, state geometry, and circuit mechanisms developed across the first six chapters of the course. Every problem can be solved directly from first principles using only the concepts and notation established in the lectures.
